composition: Gothic brick hall church and a square tower with a copper onion dome · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: The Sint-Martinusbasiliek fills a street in central Venlo. The body is a brick Gothic hall church with pointed windows and buttresses. The west tower, finished in 1953, is a sober square brick tower with a copper onion dome, not a neo-Gothic spire. The sky is clear, about 14.8°C, with wind near 9.4 km/h. The Maas boulevard is several streets away and is not in this frame.
